entries.name: NeonStack
entries.author: @Ben-Scr
entries.shortDescription: Synthwave falling-block puzzler in 3D: neon blocks, bloom, particles, three modes and an original soundtrack.
entries.description:
A complete falling-block puzzle game made with Funke: the classic 10×20 well as a 3D scene with neon blocks, bloom, particles, a colour theme per level, menus and an original soundtrack.

**Modes:** Marathon (endless, a new level every 10 lines), Sprint (40 lines against the clock) and Ultra (two minutes for points). The five best results per mode are saved.

**Rules:** close to the guideline: SRS rotation with wall kicks (180° via SRS+), 7-bag, hold, 5-piece preview, ghost piece, lock delay with move resets, T-spins (mini and full), back-to-back, combos and perfect clears.

**Controls:** Left/Right move, Down soft drop, Space hard drop, Up/X rotate right, Z/Ctrl rotate left, A rotate 180°, C/Shift hold, Esc/P pause. Gamepad supported.

The UI is in German. Scenes, materials, shaders, UI art and music are generated by `Tools/generate.py`; the rules live engine-free in `Assets/Scripts/Core` with tests in `Tools/LogicTests`.

entries.name: Voxtau
entries.author: @Ben-Scr
entries.shortDescription: Fantasy voxel sandbox: endless world, villages, kingdoms, caves, dungeons with bosses, weather and a character creator.
entries.description:
A complete voxel sandbox adventure made with Funke: an endless streamed world with no build height limit, where you mine, build and craft - and a world that lives on without you.

**World:** biomes, caves with lava lakes, sand caves, weather (rain, snow, thunderstorms with wet ground and snow cover), day and night, a far view with LOD terrain, fire spread, flowing water and lava.

**Places:** villages with trades, farms and animal pens; walled kingdoms with a king, princes, knights and archers; bandit and orc camps; spider nests, crypts and abandoned mines in caves; portals to dungeons with three bosses.

**Creatures:** skeleton knights, archers and mages, ghouls, golems, bears and wolf packs that hunt their prey; enemies notice you by sight, announce their special attacks and show health and shield bars.

**Player:** character creator with auras, first and third person, armour, a skill tree, crafting, smelting and cooking, farming, rails and minecarts, maps with waypoints, chat commands and per-world game rules. Survival, Creative, Spectator and Exploration modes; mouse and keyboard or touch.

All textures, models, scenes and sounds are generated by the Python scripts in `Tools/` (`GAME.md` describes the game, `DesignLanguage.md` its look). The original Codex image sheets in `ArtSource/` are not included, so leave `Tools/generate_assets.py` alone unless you add your own art; the generated assets are all in `Assets/`.
